client_alerts.headline: AI-generated exploits are compressing patch windows
client_alerts.body: OpenAI reported on Nov 4 that an automated pipeline produced **948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation exploits**, each paired with a candidate patch. Aggregators also report a limited GPT-6 Cyber launch for selected customers only. If the reports hold, the time from disclosure to a working exploit is shrinking. Clients should re-check vulnerability-management SLAs and the patching assumptions in their DR runbooks. The details come from secondary sources, so verify them before quoting figures to a client.

top_moves.title: Anthropic's IPO roadshow is expected to start this week, with the price range still blank
top_moves.body: Reports point to the roadshow starting the week of Nov 9, with pricing and listing the week of Nov 16. The Nov 2 S-1/A still leaves the price range blank. Investor expectations have slipped to roughly **$1.0–1.3T**, after a $1.5T figure was floated earlier.

top_moves.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back a shared robots.txt opt-out from AI training
top_moves.body: The four labs have agreed to honor a common robots.txt signal that blocks site content from AI training. This gives clients one control to set on their public websites instead of a separate rule per crawler.

top_moves.title: OpenAI moves deeper into offensive security with GPT-6 Cyber and automated kernel exploits
top_moves.body: A pipeline reported on Nov 4 produced 948 kernel exploits, with a cost reported at about $1.2M in API credits. GPT-6 Cyber is reported to be available only to selected red-team customers. Meanwhile, a gpt-6.2-astra model ID is showing up in Codex usage ahead of any announcement.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6 Cyber reportedly launched to selected customers only, and a gpt-6.2-astra model ID is appearing in Codex.
providers.detail: Images 2.6 shipped on Nov 4. Reports say OpenAI's automated pipeline produced 948 kernel exploits, each with a candidate patch. GPT-6 Cyber is reported to be limited to red-team customers. gpt-6.2-astra appears in Codex usage but is not yet in the official docs.
providers.alertReason: Automated exploit generation shortens patch windows

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: The IPO roadshow is expected to start the week of Nov 9, with valuation expectations down to about $1.0–1.3T.
providers.detail: The amended S-1/A filed Nov 2 still has no price range. The listing is targeted for the week of Nov 16, ahead of Thanksgiving. Anthropic has also signed onto the shared robots.txt AI-training opt-out. Leak reports of a new model are unconfirmed.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: No new model in the last 48 hours; Google backs the robots.txt opt-out and disclosed a $548M Qualcomm stake.
providers.detail: Google signed onto the shared AI-training opt-out signal. It also disclosed a stake in Qualcomm tied to AI data-center chips. There were no Gemini app or API releases since Omni 1.2 Flash.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot

providers.detail: This is an infrastructure move, not a feature release. The Copilot-button GA in Word, Excel and PowerPoint continues to roll out through the end of December. Microsoft also backs the robots.txt opt-out.
